title: Causal Representation Learning with Optimal Compression under Complex Treatments

C1_gen_bound.limitation: The check only verifies that empirical risk plus a nonnegative proxy term is at least empirical risk; it does not evaluate population ITE risk or Lemma 3.2 assumptions.

C2_deviation.limitation: Compares finite HSIC estimates to one large finite sample; it does not estimate alpha-hat, alpha-S-bd, curvature, confidence, or the Theorem 3.5 bound.

C3_hsic_O1.limitation: A few wall-clock measurements of this explicit one-hot implementation do not establish the paper's O(1)-in-K training complexity.

C4_normality.limitation: Normality is checked for a finite HSIC statistic, not for the paper's alpha-hat profile estimator under Assumption 3.7.

C5_pairwise_vs_agg.limitation: Counts available pairwise terms and compares one imbalance value; it does not measure PEHE, estimator variance, representation collapse, or the paper's K=20 experiment.

C6_causal_egm.limitation: Multi-Treatment CausalEGM, learned treatment embeddings, image/semi-synthetic training, PEHE, and Wasserstein-geodesic interpolation are not implemented.
